$comment: Which branch deploys where, and which Coolify application each app is. Coolify application UUIDs are identifiers, not secrets, so committing them makes the binding reviewable instead of living only in the dashboard. `enabled` is the cut-over switch: turning the pipeline on for one app is a one-line commit and turning it off again is a revert. Both start false because the Coolify applications do not exist yet — see docs/deploy/pipeline.md. An app that is enabled with no UUID fails the plan job rather than deploying nothing quietly. There is only `prod`: a dev environment was judged not worth the second VPS, so `main` is the only deploying branch and `dev` publishes images without deploying them.
